output.explanation: NIG-UK invoiced NIG-SA GBP 49,840.00 (NIG-UK:1900045234) for the P-24017 Riyadh Metro design review, and NIG-SA booked GBP 47,348.00 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018850) against the same reference 9000010931.
